channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: UDF MPs in Keralam clash over Vistadome coach credit for Madurai-Guruvayur Express
item.description: Controversy erupted when N.K. Premachandran and Kodikunnil Suresh took to social media to claim that they had been instrumental in bringing the specialised tourist-friendly railway coach to Kerala, triggering an open tug-of-war between the leaders

item.title: Keralam on high alert as rain intensifies; IMD sounds orange alert for four districts on October 22
item.description: The eastern ghat regions, southern Keralam and parts of Central Travancore received heavy overnight rain, disrupting normal life and causing waterlogging in several areas

item.title: In Bihar, 1.03 crore pensioners’ verification completed; Madhubani leads beneficiary verification
item.description: Patna ranks first in total number of pensioners. Remaining beneficiaries urged to complete their life verification at the earliest

item.title: VB-G RAM G: Restrictions lifted; workers to get work in all 38 districts of Bihar
item.description: Earlier, considering the agricultural season and also to ensure that agricultural activities were not disrupted, construction work had been suspended during the designated work-break period from October 22 to December 10, 2026.

item.title: Anthropic PB admits to having an Indian subsidiary, contradicts earlier stand in court
item.description: This violates corporate ethics, says founder of Belagavi-based company who has filed the complaint

item.title: Maharashtra State Transport staff issue notice for protest ahead of Diwali
item.description: The union will organise a procession in Mumbai on November 3, followed by a visit by a delegation to the Assembly in Nagpur on November 4. From November 5, members will stage sit-in protests outside MSRTC offices and departmental headquarters across the State

item.title: FSSAI notices to Nestle India, Zydus Wellness over ‘misleading claims’ in products
item.description: The companies have been asked to provide scientific proof to support their advertisements

item.title: Row over SMA drug distribution in Keralam unwarranted, say experts
item.description: SAT Hospital authorities deny the claim of parents of SMA children that the drug given free of cost at the hospital clinic was an “experimental drug.” Hospital authorities say what was given was the generic version of Risdiplam, the patented original formula by Roche, now manufactured by the Indian firm Natco Pharma and which has been approved by drug regulatory bodies in the country

item.title: What does eMudhra’s web security key leak mean for internet users? | Explained
item.description: The exposure of eMudhra’s private keys could allow for man-in-the-middle attacks if left unpatched on all devices

item.title: Orange alert for Kakinada, Konaseema as thunderstorms forecast; low-pressure area likely over Bay of Bengal
item.description: The districts covered by the yellow alert are Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema, West Godavari, Krishna, Bapatla, Prakasam, Sri Potti Sriramulu Nellore, Chittoor, Tirupati, Annamayya, YSR Kadapa and Sri Sathya Sai

item.title: Heavy rain triggers minor landslips; Bilaspur-Tirunelveli Superfast Express loco derails at Parassala in Keralam
item.description: No injuries reported. Train traffic along Thiruvananthapuram and Nagercoil route disrupted

item.title: India advises nationals in France to exercise caution amid unrest, curfews
item.description: The Indian mission asked nationals to stay informed through local news reports and official updates on the French government's website, gouvernement.fr

item.title: Andhra Pradesh-Transco to tap the capital markets soon
item.description: Chandrababu Naidu stated that the financial restructuring plan encompasses both short and long-term strategies drawn up to strengthen the AP-Transco’s financial position and ensure its financial sustainability

item.title: Business rights can't disregard sanctity of pilgrimage site: Gujarat government to HC on non-veg ban
item.description: Six restaurant owners have challenged the blanket ban imposed by the Gujarat Government two months ago on the sale of non-vegetarian food within a 500-metre periphery of the temple

item.title: Will get support of 275 MLAs in 294 member Assembly, says West Bengal CM
item.description: Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari gave hints that 64 of the MLAs of the rebel TMC faction will support him. BJP has 209 elected MLAs in the WB Legislative Assembly

item.title: SIR Enumeration Form may have violated electoral rules prescribing Form-4 for collecting voter details
item.description: Rule 8 of the RER, 1960, prescribes Form-4 issued by the Electoral Registration Officers to collect details of the electors in all kinds of revisions of the electoral rolls, be it Special Summary Revision or Special Intensive Revision

item.title: Mumbai Police issue notices to 24 ''X'' accounts over Sabeer Bhatia's documentary
item.description: The notices were issued on October 18, days after the documentary, allegedly containing false and disparaging claims about Prime Minister Narendra Modi and industrialist Gautam Adani, sparked a controversy

item.title: CMRL-Exalogic case: In an update from oral pronouncement, Supreme Court specifies freeze period as 10 days in published order
item.description: The oral pronouncement in open court on October 21 had specifically dictated the time of stay as a week or seven days

item.title: Schools closed in five Tamil Nadu districts after overnight rain
item.description: Mamallapuram recorded the highest rainfall at 9 cm, followed by Tenkasi and Sattankulam in Thoothukudi district, which received 6 cm each. Tirunelveli, Mayiladuthurai and Tiruvarur recorded 5 cm each

item.title: Parvinder Singh Jhota: Who was the anti-drug activist, why was he killed
item.description: Known for raising his voice against the illegal sale of addictive substances at chemist shops, Jhota was shot in broad daylight inside a medical store at a busy marketplace in Punjab’s Mansa

item.title: Controversy erupts after ‘protest’ photographs by Priyanka Gandhi’s son allegedly get removed from Bikaner House exhibition
item.description: “Five hours ago, the Bikaner House Management forced me to remove the bulk of the artworks displayed in my show 'No Idea Is Final”, which opens this evening at 7 p.m.. The photos were of the youth protests in Delhi. Apparently the content is objectionable,” says Raihan Vadra

item.title: Namma Metro Phase 3: Karnataka issues third land acquisition notification for Orange Line package
item.description: Dated October 16, 2026, and published in the Karnataka State Gazette, the notification identifies properties measuring a total of 13,409.05 sq. m. across 11 entries

item.title: Andhra Pradesh SEC halts election process for 100 ULBs after Supreme Court order
item.description: SEC will issue an order on the ULB elections on October 22 after obtaining reports from Collectors, District Election and Police authorities

item.title: U.P. CM Yogi issues directions for strict legal action in cases of land encroachment
item.description: Officials must impose strict legal action on anyone who illegally occupies land or dispossesses vulnerable people, while urging dialogue to resolve familial property disputes and promising swift assistance to victims seeking government benefits or medical treatment, says Uttar Pradesh CM

item.title: 'Much, much bigger leaders than me': Dipke hails Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka after release
item.description: Das and Ranka were released after the expiry of judicial custody in connection with the October 14 protest at Jantar Mantar.

item.title: BJD slams BJP for personal attack on Naveen over his demand for CJP leaders’ release
item.description: Naveen wants to create a situation like Bangladesh in the country to promote his own politics, alleges BJP

item.title: Haryana Congress flays BJP government over its failure to keep poll promises
item.description: Deteriorating law and order, farmers’ grievances, unemployment, corruption, poor healthcare services and drug abuse are among other issues. The Congress leaders cornered the BJP on the government’s completion of two years of its third term in Haryana

item.title: Surrendered Maoist found dead in rehabilitation facility: Police
item.description: “Around 7 a.m., fellow surrendered Maoists in the facility informed the police that Baddu was found dead in one of the bathrooms,” said Bijapur SP

item.title: West Bengal government sets up SIT headed by retired justice to probe Durga Puja pandal stampede
item.description: After the incident, Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari said that the SIT will be headed by a sitting judge of Calcutta High Court

item.title: Kochi pharma firm loses ₹99 lakh in alleged impersonation fraud
item.description: According to the FIR, the accused hacked a mobile phone used by the company’s accounts department and managed to save a phone number as that of the CEO, using the WhatsApp display picture used by him

item.title: Steep steps, wide gaps make train travel a challenge for elderly, differently abled
item.description: Commuters seek gradual replacement of footboards to make trains safer and more accessible

item.title: Student killed after being hit by train in Kozhikode
item.description: Police say she was attempting to cross the railway tracks when the Vande Bharat Express, travelling towards Thiruvananthapuram, struck her

item.title: Greens oppose move to revive Cheekkalloor airstrip project in Wayanad
item.description: Samiti warns that airstrip would displace more than 1,000 families, destroy around 500 acres of paddy fields and threaten water security in Wayanad and adjoining areas of Karnataka and Tamil Nadu

item.title: Man booked for allegedly defaming Aluva MLA on social media
item.description: The accused has been booked on charges including criminal defamation

item.title: J&K HC summons Srinagar Deputy Commissioner over detention order under PSA passed ‘without application of mind’
item.description: In the present case, the nature of the allegations, the apparent absence of specific material particulars on the grounds of detention and the prima facie concern regarding the manner in which the detention order has been formulated warrant further examination, Justice Nargal observes

item.title: Kuki-Zo groups demand reimposition of President’s Rule in Manipur
item.description: President’s Rule was last imposed in the State from February 2025 to February 2026; Kuki-Zo groups say 32 members of their community have died in ethnic violence since March, while economic embargoes hurt Kuki-Zo villages

item.title: 23rd Kaladarshini cultural festival from October 26 in Vijayawada
AAP alleges corruption in DJB on spraying of anti-frothing agent in Yamuna
item.description: “The container belonging to a company is marked ‘Defoamer Stock’, which means the tanks and all the equipment used to spray chemicals to remove foam from the Yamuna have already been set up,” says AAP Delhi president

item.title: T.N. government fixes car purchase ceiling at ₹26 lakh for Ministers, other key Assembly functionaries; sets ₹15-lakh cap for other MLAs
Trade, defence and the Russia-Ukraine conflict to dominate Modi-Tusk talks on October 22
item.description: Polish PM to hold meetings Delhi and Bengaluru, both sides finalising a confidentiality agreement for defence tech sensitivities on Russia

item.title: Vijay congratulates Kasthuri Rajamani for clinching silver medal in 5th Asian Para Games
IIT-Madras to train bio-tech graduates in practical skills
Parvinder Singh Jhota murder case: CBI takes over probe; opposition demands Punjab CM’s resignation
item.description: The anti-drug activist’s family is expected to be examined by the CBI team, led by senior DIG, in Mansa

item.title: Tribal held for possession of country-made gun, explosives in Jawadhu Hills
item.description: The team apprehended one of the suspects and seized the country-made gun and explosives from him

item.title: Will not rest until J&K is freed from separatist, terrorist elements: J&K L-G Manoj Sinha
item.description: The Lieutenant-Governor said the Government of India’s commitment to strengthening peace and progress in Jammu and Kashmir

item.title: Banned tobacco, suspect snacks seized in Mumbai; FDA crackdown nets ₹3.11 crore across Maharashtra
item.description: The FDA said the banned-product seizures in Mumbai and Jalna, including vehicles and other items, were valued at ₹93.42 lakh

item.title: Three held for suspected deer hunt in Karnataka; rifle, night-vision equipment seized in Hyderabad
Burglars decamp with 18.50 sovereigns of gold, cash in Tirupattur
item.description: A case was registered and special teams were formed to nab the suspects

item.title: Forest Department restores Poosi Forest Palace near Arani for public viewing
item.description: The restoration work was carried out at a cost of ₹11.54 crore

item.title: Economist Prabhakar to join Dipke, Prakash Raj, Neha at nationwide anti-SIR protests on October 23
item.description: The People Against SIR alliance has called for marches across the country, demanding the scrapping of the electoral roll revision exercise and the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar

item.title: Ladakh administration dissolves hill council in Kargil, announces panchayat elections on November 21
item.description: The administration of Ladakh has notified 100 elected constituencies for the eight districts of the region; nominations will close on November 2 while the Model Code of Conduct has come into force with immediate effect

item.title: Fresh weather system to fuel another spell of heavy rain in Tamil Nadu
item.description: The spell of wet weather is expected to continue till October 27, 2026, with a low-pressure area forming over southwest Bay of Bengal off Tamil Nadu’s coast during early hours of October 21

item.title: Kerala Police to conduct intelligence-based operations against spas: Ravada Chandrasekhar
item.description: Probe under way into alleged sexual assault of a 16-year-old girl from Andhra Pradesh at a spa in Kovalam

item.title: India-Australia joint military exercise begins in capital
CMFRI launches open-sea mussel longline farming unit at Vizhinjam
Local body polls in Andhra Pradesh: YSRCP welcomes Supreme Court directions, urges SEC to ensure free and fair elections
item.description: Sajjala urges the State Election Commissioner to ensure CCTV surveillance at the nomination centres

item.title: Meira Kumar entitled to compensation for land acquired by government, says Patna High Court
item.description: Justice Khatim Reza, in an order on October 6, quashed the District Collector’s order that had attempted to seize Patna land by unilaterally cancelling the family’s 60-year-old land records

item.title: ULB polls in Andhra Pradesh: SEC orders strict implementation of Supreme Court’s directions
item.description: Poll process in all Municipal Corporations and Municipalities will continue as per schedule, except 19 civic bodies which reported large-scale complaints of intimidation and physical attacks, says Punetha

item.title: No passes, no problem: Dasara fans find their vantage points
14 candidates in fray for Guntur Mayor post; election symbols allotted
item.description: TDP's Lakshmi Aparna gets bicycle symbol; YSRCP candidate Padmasridevi allotted ceiling fan
